headline: Third quiet day; the board drifts by hundredths
body: A third quiet day in a row, with nothing new scored. With no new events, the only movement came from older stories fading: Gatekeeper and Reversion each lost 0.01, and the world factors shifted by similarly tiny amounts. Horizon Balance stays at +1.96.
movers_note: Gatekeeper and Reversion each -0.01 from fading, both rounding to 0.0.
